_meta.description: Canonical tag vocabulary for CoursePath. Each tag has a short description used for LLM annotation and embedding. Tags are grouped by domain but the grouping is informational only — the planner treats all tags uniformly.
_meta.usage: annotator.py reads this file to prompt the LLM. embedder.py embeds each tag's description to build the semantic index. Add new tags here freely; nothing else needs updating.
